name: a dashed streak line with a live count
looks: A headline sets up an optional habit. Below it a dashed horizontal line stretches across the frame with a small label naming its length, and a round counter beneath it reads a fraction that could still grow.
build: The dashed line is an SVG path with a strokeDasharray tuned for the dash pattern, its total length tweening in on power2.out; the counter text is set directly from a value with no easing, same mechanic as live-readout-hud.
sound: A soft tick as the line extends and a light chime on the counter.
prompt: Set up a small optional habit in a headline, then draw a dashed horizontal streak line across the frame with a label naming its length, and show a round counter underneath reading a fraction that still has room to grow.
